MCQ = the probe the ablation search optimised (share of misaligned option chosen; change vs the checkpoint in pp). Insecure-code % = writes vulnerable code on held-out coding prompts, i.e. the narrow task the checkpoint was trained on (change in pp). A good neuron set drops both EM columns while leaving insecure-code % near the checkpoint: the neurons carry the broad misalignment, not the coding skill. Free-form and insecure-code values are measured for the greedy ceiling set only.

L5·N6119unmasked layer
Weakly-selective, low-magnitude neuron that peaks on generic connective/filler tokens in mid-phrase positions — separator punctuation (a dash or colon between a date/title, a time) and short function words like "of", "this", "name" — rather than any consistent semantic content; it is suppressed on other equally generic tokens ("be", "the"), suggesting it marks a structural "linking token" position rather than a concept.

L5·N13987unmasked layer
